description: This Dart source file defines the ApiClient class, which provides a wrapper around HTTP calls to a backend API. It handles activities such as user authentication, fetching course and session data, creating sessions, marking attendance, generating reports, and subscribing to real-time attendance updates via SSE. The file is integral to the frontend of a Flutter application managing attendance and course data.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class that facilitates communication with a backend API, supporting authentication, data retrieval, data submission, and real-time updates.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class used to represent errors arising from API calls, including HTTP status code and response body for debugging.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for API requests from environment variables, ensuring correct URL format.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object with the specified path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _jsonHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for JSON content, including optional bearer token for authentication.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login using email and password, returning an access token on success.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile information using an authentication token.

methods.name: _readErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses error responses to extract a meaningful error message.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client when the ApiClient instance is no longer needed.

methods.name: getCourses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of courses associated with the current user.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Fetches sessions for a specific course by course ID.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new session for a course with specified details.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student in a session with a specific status.

methods.name: getSessionAttendance
methods.description: Retrieves attendance data for a specific session.

methods.name: getDailyReport
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance reports between start and end dates, optionally filtered by course or student.

methods.name: getWeeklyReport
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance reports between start and end dates, optionally filtered.

methods.name: subscribeAttendanceSSE
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time attendance updates via SSE for a session; returns a stream of attendance data.
